dimensions.name: Authority
dimensions.description: The basis on which a digital representation is allowed to exist and act.

dimensions.name: Consent
dimensions.description: The permission and boundaries governing likeness, identity, or representational use.

dimensions.name: Context
dimensions.description: The environment in which an avatar is presented, interpreted, or relied upon.

dimensions.name: Integrity
dimensions.description: The durability, accuracy, and tamper resistance of representational signals.

dimensions.name: Accountability
dimensions.description: The ability to assign responsibility for creation, deployment, disclosure, and misuse.
